title: Wall Mount Tumbler Toothbrush Holder 5-Inch Projection Solid Brass, Mambo Collection | Unlacquered Brass | Allied Brass
description:
Add space-saving storage at the sink with this wall mount tumbler toothbrush holder, crafted from solid brass in Unlacquered Brass, which is a living finish that develops a unique natural patina over time, gaining character and warmth with age. Each piece becomes one-of-a-kind, perfect for those who appreciate authentic materials that tell a story. Designed for the Mambo collection, it fits transitional bathroom hardware plans and pairs easily with versatile bath accessories.

Highlights:
- Unlacquered Brass develops a unique, one-of-a-kind patina over time
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Concealed screw mounting hardware for a clean look
- Multiple designer finish options available
- Installation hardware included

Specs:
- Category: Tumbler Toothbrush Holders
- Mounting type: Wall mount
- Dimensions: 4.5 in (L) x 3.5 in (W) x 4.7 in (H)
- Projection: 5 in
- Weight capacity: 6 lb
- Product weight: 2.4 lb
- Screw size: #8 X1 1/4"
- Included items: Toothbrush holder and all installation hardware
- Assembly required: No
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
